uncited: **Address Generation:** Use hardware to generate sampling point positions.
**Neighbor Access:** Access the 8 neighbor voxels in the original dataset corresponding to the rounded addresses.
**Interpolation:** Perform backward mapping rotation using weighted interpolation among the 8 density values.
*   **Discreteness Artifacts:** The precalculated weights have limited resolution (6 bits).
This discreteness can cause visible artifacts.
The architecture was later commercially distributed by Volume Graphics GmbH .
